QuestInfo.name: Gared's Decision
QuestInfo.0: Bitsie sneaks Edward into the village for safety in the midst of the Yeti panic, but the villagers stumble upon them. When the villagers insist that the Snow Child is responsible for the Yeti attack, Gared has little choice but to lock the boy up in the storeroom until the crisis is addressed. \r\nUnbeknownst to the villagers, the chief makes a special request of you...
